dialogue_or_narration.tail_pointing: 画面外（卫生间门口方向）

Several small splashes of water visible on the toilet seat ring under close inspection — a small but damning detail. Beside the toilet a roll of toilet paper on a holder, plain off-white ceramic tile background. Bathroom ceiling light from upper left casting a warm white wash on the scene. No people in the frame. Cool blue-grey tone in the shadows of the tile. Mood: the first piece of evidence on the inspection list, the camera shows what the wife is looking at. Text watermark 'P05-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
